title: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer planeswalker and leader of the Infinite Consortium who deceives Elesh Norn into granting him a darksteel body, then escapes and schemes in the shadows.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler on her throne in the Fair Basilica who grants Tezzeret his reward and is afraid of Elspeth Tirel.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor and scientist who builds Tezzeret's darksteel body and knows of Urabrask's plots.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A traitor who arrived with Tezzeret and was struck down by Elspeth's weapon; Tezzeret blames her for his failures.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian thane whom Elesh Norn calls an apostate for moving against her.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker whose weapon struck Rona and whom Tezzeret presents as the leader of the enemy.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who was compleated; Tezzeret recalls her flayed in Jin-Gitaxias's laboratory.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A young nezumi and Tamiyo's son who ambushes Tezzeret in Towashi and is spared.

entities.name: Estel
entities.description: A young boy of Tidehollow whom Tezzeret sends to Bant with a box of etherium.

entities.name: Baltrice
entities.description: Tezzeret's second-in-command in the Infinite Consortium who set up safehouses.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The planeswalker who scraped out Tezzeret's mind and keeps the location of his tower from him.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem whose dismembered body Tezzeret brought to Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Rafiq
entities.description: A Bant knight-general to whom Estel is told to bring the box.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor in rebellion whose domain produces darksteel and whom Jin-Gitaxias knows about.

entities.name: Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who saved Tezzeret from the brink of death.

entities.name: Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker now compleated, cited with Tamiyo as an example of servitude.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane Tezzeret returns to.

entities.name: Fair Basilica
entities.description: Elesh Norn's cathedral with aspirants, angels, chancellors and the Alabaster Host.

entities.name: Tidehollow
entities.description: The forsaken underground of Esper where Tezzeret was born.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Tezzeret's home shard, with an elite that relegated the poor to Tidehollow.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: A Kamigawan city whose undercity hides one of Baltrice's safehouses.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of Towashi, where Tezzeret is unwelcome.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: The shard to which Estel is sent to warn the Knights of Bant.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane Tezzeret abandoned after his forces were overwhelmed.

entities.name: The Infinite Consortium
entities.description: Tezzeret's shadowy organization with safehouses across the Multiverse.

entities.name: The Alabaster Host
entities.description: Armored legions of the Fair Basilica that guard its avenues.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde now invading plane after plane.

entities.name: The Planar Bridge
entities.description: A device in Tezzeret's body that burns his flesh and requires treatment.

entities.name: The Reality Chip
entities.description: A module dripping with glistening oil that Jin-Gitaxias uses against Tezzeret.

entities.name: Darksteel
entities.description: An indestructible metal that Tezzeret receives as a body.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: A rare metal that Tezzeret reshapes into a message and gives to Estel.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: Elesh Norn's invasion of the Multiverse.

events.summary: Tezzeret arrives at the Fair Basilica through the Planar Bridge carrying Rona's remains and demands to see Elesh Norn.
events.quote: I must see Mother,

events.summary: Elesh Norn summons Tezzeret and orders Rona's remains sent to Jin-Gitaxias.
events.quote: Send the other to Jin-Gitaxias for reconditioning.

events.summary: Tezzeret blames his failure on Rona and Sheoldred's treachery, and Norn accepts it.
events.quote: We were routed when our own troops turned on us.

events.summary: Elesh Norn questions Tezzeret's love for her, while Tezzeret restrains his urge to kill her.
events.quote: One well-placed thrust of his sharpened arm could impale her head or take it right off.

events.summary: Tezzeret tells Norn that the Planeswalkers' new leader is Elspeth Tirel, wielding a blade of white light, and Norn grows fearful.
events.quote: The leader's name is Elspeth Tirel.

events.summary: Tezzeret asks for his promised darksteel body and collapses, and Norn declares a promise is a promise.
events.quote: A promise is a promise.

events.summary: Tezzeret wakes bound in Jin-Gitaxias's laboratory, where Tamiyo was compleated.
events.quote: So it was happening. His reward, finally here.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias melts Tezzeret's etherium arm to bond his spine to the darksteel body.
events.quote: Tezzeret watched as the embodiment of his own exceptionalism melted into slag.

events.summary: Tezzeret's head and spine are transferred into the darksteel body and he has a vision of a clock and an island of metal.
events.quote: Then his head and spine were separated from his body

events.summary: Tezzeret awakens in his new body but cannot planeswalk because the slab is inlaid with silver.
events.quote: Tezzeret had fallen into the same trap.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias reveals a new Reality Chip and says he knows of Urabrask and the Mirran attacks and will let them unfold.
events.quote: There is no violating an agreement already broken.

events.summary: Tezzeret uses a telemin bond to take control of a captive scrapchief in a tank.
events.quote: Give me control , Phyrexian , thought Tezzeret.

events.summary: Tezzeret smashes the tank and the slab through the scrapchief, but Jin-Gitaxias kills it, so Tezzeret planeswalks away.
events.quote: Tezzeret planeswalked away.

events.summary: Tezzeret arrives in Tidehollow, the slum where he grew up, and laughs.
events.quote: For Tezzeret, there was only one word associated with Tidehollow that truly resonated.

events.summary: Tezzeret drives off a gang of children by animating a knife into its owner's hand, leaving the boy Estel behind.
events.quote: he turned, stood, and cast a spell to animate the knife in the leader's hand

events.summary: Tezzeret retrieves his mother's box of etherium from the ruins of his childhood home.
events.quote: This was his mother's handiwork, the last remnant of the hobby that gave her solace amid the squalor.

events.summary: Phyrexians break through the cave ceiling, invading Tidehollow.
events.quote: Bone-white metal. The Phyrexians had arrived.

events.summary: Tezzeret sends Estel with the box and an enchanted knife to Bant, telling him to say an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent him.
events.quote: When you see Rafiq, tell him that an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent you.

events.summary: Tezzeret leaves for the Blind Eternities in his father's cloak as Tidehollow is slaughtered.
events.quote: A fitting goodbye

events.summary: Tezzeret travels across planes already overrun by Phyrexians, finding Baltrice's safehouses compromised.
events.quote: Elesh Norn's "great work" was unfolding faster than Tezzeret could have imagined.

events.summary: Nashi shoots Tezzeret in Towashi's undercity and demands to know where Tamiyo is.
events.quote: Tell me where she is.

events.summary: Tezzeret turns on Nashi's gang and crushes their motorbikes.
events.quote: lifting the bikes into the air and then slamming them together with a gruesome crunch

events.summary: Tezzeret tells the wounded Nashi that his mother still lives and will come for him.
events.quote: Your mother still lives.

events.summary: Tezzeret finds Baltrice's safehouse behind a gaming parlor and gathers supplies.
events.quote: Inside, he found exactly what he was looking for.

events.summary: Tezzeret travels to the ruins of his tower and resolves to wait for the winner of the war to weaken before making his move.
events.quote: Then—and only then—would he make his move.
